apiGuide.title: Setting up and getting the most from your API key
apiGuide.why.title: Why do I need an API key?
apiGuide.why.direct: You contract directly with the AI provider, so this app takes no cut. You pay the provider's own rates with no subscription on top.
apiGuide.why.cost: In practice a single stock analysis costs roughly 5-15 JPY (about $0.03-$0.10), depending on the model and how much source material you attach. You pay only for what you use, so a month with no analysis costs nothing.
apiGuide.why.local: Your key is stored only in this machine's config directory. It is never sent to our servers, and the screen shows a masked string only.
apiGuide.steps.title: Getting an OpenAI API key (5 steps)
apiGuide.step.account.title: Create an account
apiGuide.step.account.body: Go to platform.openai.com and sign up with an email address or Google account. This is separate from ChatGPT, so you do not need a paid ChatGPT plan.
apiGuide.step.billing.title: Add a payment method (a $5 top-up is enough to start)
apiGuide.step.billing.body: Register a card on the Billing page and add $5 of credit. **Analysis will not run with a zero balance.** Starting small lets you try it before adding more.
apiGuide.step.create.title: Create the key on the API keys page
apiGuide.step.create.body: Open "API keys" in the left menu and click "Create new secret key". Any name works (for example, StoQ).
apiGuide.step.copy.title: Copy the string starting with `sk-`
apiGuide.step.copy.body: **It is shown only once.** Once you close the dialog you cannot see it again, so copy it now. If you lose it, just create a new one.
apiGuide.step.paste.title: Paste it into the settings screen
apiGuide.step.paste.body: In this app, open "AI settings" then the "API keys & models" tab, paste it into the OpenAI field and save. A green badge means you are done.
apiGuide.limit.title: Preventing overspend (usage limits)
apiGuide.limit.body: OpenAI lets you set a usage limit under Settings -> Limits. Set it to, say, $10 per month and the API stops once you hit it, **which reliably prevents an unexpected bill.** We recommend setting this up first.
apiGuide.trouble.title: Troubleshooting
apiGuide.trouble.429.cause: No payment method on file, or your credit balance has run out.
apiGuide.trouble.429.fix: Add a payment method on the Billing page and top up your balance.
apiGuide.trouble.401.cause: The key was copied incorrectly (stray whitespace, or it was cut short).
apiGuide.trouble.401.fix: Create a new key and paste it again, making sure no extra spaces are included.

cloud.scope.title: 🔒 What this app can access
cloud.scope.body: This app requests only drive.appdata. That permission covers a hidden, app-private folder inside Google Drive — it cannot even list your photos, documents or any other file.
cloud.scope.contents: Backups contain only the analyses, chat history and portfolio databases. Your API keys and license key are never uploaded.
cloud.clientId.label: Google OAuth client ID (desktop app)
cloud.clientId.help: In Google Cloud Console, go to APIs & Services → Credentials, create an OAuth client ID of type "Desktop app", and enable the Google Drive API. No client secret is needed (we use PKCE).
cloud.autoBackup.hint: Uploads a snapshot when the app starts. A failure never blocks startup. Older generations beyond the most recent 10 are pruned.
cloud.restore.confirmBody: This replaces the data on this computer with the newest cloud backup. Your current data is copied aside first. Proceed?

tour.title: Getting started
tour.welcome.title: Welcome to {{app}}
tour.welcome.body:
An app for working through fundamental analysis of US and global equities together with AI.

It hands the financial data it fetches, plus any filings you load, to an LLM and produces a 20-point assessment. Let's walk through four short steps.
tour.keys.title: 1. Register an API key first
tour.keys.body:
You need an API key from OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini to run the AI.
Register one from the "AI settings" button at the top.

Keys are stored in the OS application settings directory; the screen only ever shows a masked string.
To use SEC EDGAR you also need a User-Agent in "AppName email" format.
tour.ticker.title: 2. Look up a ticker
tour.ticker.body:
Type a ticker (e.g. NVDA, 7203.T) into the field at the top and press Analyze to fetch the price, financial metrics, quarterly trend and SEC filing status.

Into the "Watchlist" panel at the bottom of the left sidebar you can paste a list like AAPL|Apple|Phone and register everything at once.
tour.documents.title: 3. Load primary source documents
tour.documents.body:
Drop earnings decks or 10-K files (PDF / DOCX / PPTX) into the drop zone.
The more material you provide, the sharper the analysis.

Long documents are condensed automatically, but by extracting the original sentences rather than summarising, so no facts are altered.
tour.analyze.title: 4. Analyze — and ask when unsure
tour.analyze.body:
"Run AI analysis" in the analysis panel generates the 20-point assessment.
You can change every pass/fail threshold under Settings → Rules & thresholds.

If you get stuck, the "? Help" button at the bottom right can answer questions any time.
